title: Bass Haven

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Generally boats 22ft and under are able to launch. Water levels may change this. We can assist in the decision to help with the boat launch for safe operation. Access our useful map of Lake St. Clair and surrounding waterways, to help you in finding the perfect spot for your next

services.name: Ice Fishing
services.desc: Ice fishing brings many anglers to the Mitchell’s Bay area this time of year. Whether you are walking or have an ATV/snowmobile, you are never to far away from the fish. If conditions allow it, we allow people to access the lake via our boat launch, to get on the lake. Ice thickness will determine whether the access will only be for people walking, or if ATV/snowmobiles will be allowed. For a small parking fee, anglers and families can enjoy a great day on the “Hard Water”. Access our useful map of Lake St. Clair and surrounding waterways, to help you in finding the perfect spot for your next

blurb: Bass Haven is a family operated Sport Fishing and Hunting Outfitter, established over 40 years ago, located on Lake St.Clair at Mitchell’s Bay, Ontario, Canada. There is always something going on at Bass Haven. Fishing, Hunting and Ice fishing keeps us busy
